title: Kernel of restriction generated by boundary inertia
statement: Let $C_0$ be a smooth geometrically connected separated curve of finite type over $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, let $j_0:U_0\hookrightarrow C_0$ be a dense open immersion, and put $S_0=C_0\setminus U_0$. Let $W(U_0)\to W(C_0)$ be the degree-preserving homomorphism of Weil groups induced by $j_0$, and for each $x\in S_0$ let $I_x$ be the local inertia subgroup in the decomposition-group map of [d-real-boundary]. Then the kernel of $W(U_0)\to W(C_0)$ is the smallest closed normal subgroup of $W(U_0)$ containing the images of all $I_x$.
